prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1726 exposes `keepAliveInterval` as a named option on `WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransportOptions` and tracks the per-stream timer inside the `StreamMapping` interface, giving callers control over the interval and ensuring the timer is reachable for cleanup from any code path that holds the mapping. The configurable-option approach in #1726 is also recorded as a minor feature addition (changeset present), while #2124 is a patch-only local fix with no changeset.

clusters.pick_reason: #2215 applies the same `replace(/\/+$/, '')` normalization as #2214 in both discovery path functions, but additionally fixes a consequential bug in `shouldAttemptFallback`: after normalization the root path becomes `''` not `'/'`, so #2214's guard `pathname === '/'` would never match and would incorrectly retry fallback at the root. #2215 corrects this to `pathname === ''` and factors both sites into a shared `normalizeDiscoveryPath()` helper, keeping the two call sites consistent. #2214's diff is strictly a subset of #2215's.
